claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing surface has an alter_item_kind effect atom, but activated abilities can only attach to self, target, area, or mark. This item's bonus-action form change needs to target the held weapon itself.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.current_item_kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several grants and one reactive property apply only in specific weapon forms. The passive surface can gate on armor or wielded-weapon category, but not on the current named form of the same magic item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). ... Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).
